subject: RAISE statement
notes: "Identifier-1 is a sending operand." (cite.py --check 14.9.29.3 -> OK §14.9.29.3 3)). BindRaise resolves identifier-1 through ResolveSending (the sending-operand chokepoint), and EmitRaiseObject only READS it (PlaceRenderer.Read) into ExceptionState.SetObject. EXCEPTION-OBJECT itself (a predefined reference that may not be a receiving operand, §8.4.3.6.3 SR1) is accepted as identifier-1 (probe/raise/sr2b.cob prints the handler line for `RAISE EXCEPTION-OBJECT`), consistent with sending-only use. No test asserts sending-ness specifically -> test-needed.
